ns2:section.sectionText: Meets with ADV 509 (CRN 68920). This course introduces students to the foundations of entrepreneurship and evolving business models for media ventures. Working both individually and in teams, students will develop an idea for a new business and progress it through many of the stages of entrepreneurship learned in class: ideation; market research; business planning; finance, funding, and monetization; product design; and promotion. For the final project, teams will pitch their businesses to a panel of industry professionals. Please note: This section will have synchronous (live) sessions, to be held during the scheduled class day/time listed in Course Explorer.
